interpretation: Article 44 applies as a general rule to services supplied to a taxable person acting as such. Its text contains business-establishment and receiving fixed-establishment branches. The candidate is therefore restricted to cases where a reviewer expressly records that no relevant recipient fixed establishment changes the receiving location. It does not resolve fixed establishment. Article 47 and other specific rules are screened out by explicit service classification and special-rule review. Hungarian NAV guidance supports the corresponding Article 37(1) domestic general rule. The exact current NJT primary text was not directly retrievable in this run, and is recorded unverified.
